body:
_Migrated from issue #1186, filed 2026-07-28._

The `a11y.spec.ts` gate fails on clean `origin/main` (37aa39c) with `color-contrast [serious]` on **every** route it scans, light theme only. Its `KNOWN` allowlist is documented as needing to stay empty, so this is the gate sitting red rather than named debt.

Found while baselining an unrelated card fix (#1185). Not caused by that change — reproduced on a clean checkout of main with nothing applied.

## Reproduce

```
cd repo/frontend && npx playwright test a11y --workers=1
```
against `cwn-local`.

## Result

15 failures. Every one is `<route>/light`; the dark pass is clean throughout. Affected: grid, book-detail, edit-book, smart-shelf-builder, account, advanced-search, shelves, duplicates, admin, announcement-kofi, **login (unauthenticated)**.

Login is worth calling out — it has no BookCard and no library chrome, which is what rules out any one component as the cause.

## Offending pairs

| Foreground | Background | Ratio | Needs | Occurrences |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `#9aa7b2` | `#ffffff` | 2.45 | 4.5 | 258 |
| `#ece8e1` | `#ffffff` | 1.22 | 4.5 | 10 |
| `#54606b` | `#1b2530` | 2.40 | 4.5 | 9 |
| `#23292f` | `#1b2530` | 1.05 | 4.5 | 9 |
| `#9aa7b2` | `#e7e1d4` | 1.88 | 4.5 | 8 |

Recurring nodes: `a[href$="favorites"]`, `a[href$="about"]`, `._triggerLabel_*`, `._customizeBtn_* > span`, and every smart-shelf link (`a[title="Reading now"]`, `a[title="Highly Rated"]`, …).

## Two candidate causes — not yet distinguished

1. **A real light-theme token regression.** `#9aa7b2` on white at 2.45:1 is a straightforward AA failure, and it accounts for the large majority of nodes.
2. **A harness artifact.** `axeScan` flips the theme with `document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme)` rather than going through the app's own theme switcher. Rows 3 and 4 above pair *light*-theme text (`#54606b` is the light `--text-muted`) against a *dark* surface (`#1b2530`) — a hybrid state a real user may never reach. If some surfaces are themed by another mechanism, the raw attribute flip would manufacture those pairs.

The two aren't exclusive: (1) can be genuine while (2) inflates the count. Whoever picks this up should first switch the scan to the real theme control and re-measure — that separates them in one run, and it decides whether the mixed pairs are noise to discard or the actual bug.

Worth resolving either way: while the gate is red, it can't catch the next a11y regression.

## Also seen on baseline

`cover-upload-refresh.spec.ts` (#989) times out at 45s on clean main too, desktop and mobile. Likely unrelated to the above; noting it here so it isn't mistaken for fallout from a later change.
title: [bug] SPA a11y gate is red on main: color-contrast (serious) on every light-theme route
